_doc: Visually confirmed ANIMAL presence intervals (inclusive, epoch ms) on camera 101, read off contact sheets at 2 s. A frame inside an interval is a positive; a frame outside is not counted as a negative for recall (the subject may be entering/leaving), it is only used for the crop-cost figures. False positives are measured on the separate 'quiet' windows.
